subject: "LCAT" functions for post-processing of multigroup LCA results

messages.author: 2691be7b4c0f5173
messages.subject: "LCAT" functions for post-processing of multigroup LCA results
parts:
Hi All,

Wondering if anyone has a file (or the code) of the so-called LCAT functions developed by researchers at the London School of Economics. These functions are built using the mplusautomation package, and are designed to work with multigroup LCA modeling output from Mplus in R. 

It seems that a file containing the functions used to be available here (but the link is now dead): https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/lcat/lcat-functions-for-r/

I'm trying to do some post-processing of multigroup LCA modeling, in particular looking at response probabilities, which is challenging when using the "covariate specification" in Mplus (as opposed to the knownclass approach). 

Further details of different approaches to MLCA in Mplus are provided in this report--and the LCAT functions are described in Ch. 7: https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/lcat/files/2015/08/LCAT_Mplus_and_R.pdf

Thanks in advance!
Trevor
